economy.summary: His campaign site proposes growing the local tax base by supporting small businesses through funding, grants, and zoning, and calls for bringing back the Small Business Hub so that resources and relief are attainable.
economy.short: Proposes supporting small businesses; bring back Small Business Hub.

taxes.summary: Says he supports property tax reform to ease the tax burden on seniors and working families, and proposes creating a Property Tax Reform Commission.
taxes.short: Supports property tax reform easing burden on seniors, working families.

abortion.summary: His campaign site says that in light of the overruling of Roe v. Wade, women's rights have become more precarious than ever, and pledges to protect women's rights; the site does not detail specific abortion legislation.
abortion.short: Pledges to protect women's rights after Roe reversal; no specifics.

education.summary: His campaign site says education is a right, not a privilege, and that every child has a right to a safe, rigorous, equitable, and fully funded public education; he calls for increased state funding, universal pre-K, and full-day kindergarten for all.
education.short: Calls education a right; wants universal pre-K, full-day kindergarten.

healthcare.summary: Says he will introduce a bill mandating that every health insurance plan offered in Pennsylvania include affordable mental health and substance abuse treatment.
healthcare.short: Proposes mandating insurance include mental health, substance abuse treatment.

energy.summary: His campaign site calls for investing in new technology, green businesses, research, and sustainability projects such as solar installations and electric vehicle charging stations.
energy.short: Calls for investing in green businesses, solar, EV charging.

guns.summary: As state representative, introduced a bill to shorten the deadline for reporting records used in Pennsylvania State Police background checks for gun purchases from seven days to four days, with an added requirement to develop electronic transfer of those records.
guns.short: Introduced bill shortening gun background-check record reporting deadline.
